chapters.label: Live: the 2019 final
chapters.text: The 2019 European futsal final, in Almaty. The whistle goes! Sporting beat Kairat two to one, and their goalkeeper Guitta celebrates.

chapters.label: How he did it
chapters.text: Here is how he did it. A quick shot from close range, and his hand flies out. Saved!

chapters.label: Replay: watch the foot
chapters.text: Again, slowly. Guitta watches the shooter’s foot, not his body. The hips point one way, but the foot sends it the other. He is already moving. Saved!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Try it with a friend. Watch the shooter’s foot, not their body, to react quicker!
